x-gopos-purchase-recommendation.formula: if net_sales > 0: max(stock_minimum, avg_daily_net_sales * (cover_days + safety_days)) - current_stock; else excluded

x-gopos-consignment.item_picker: active physical stock items where category.is_konsi=1
x-gopos-consignment.business_engine: sp_konsi_post_core shared by API and sp_konsi_post Web wrapper
x-gopos-consignment.accounting_reason: Existing Web posts accounting on settlement, not on consignment intake.
x-gopos-consignment.draft_update_rule: DRAFT + active period; header-only requires update; replacing items additionally requires insert+delete
x-gopos-consignment.draft_delete_rule: DRAFT only; old-period draft may be deleted only when item_count=0
x-gopos-consignment.settle_rule: POSTED only; original period may already be closed/changed, using sp_konsi_settle Web engine

x-gopos-stock-opname.business_engine: same trx_opname/trx_opname_dt triggers and sp_opname_post_micro used by Web
x-gopos-stock-opname.accounting: same Web accPostWarning(opname) after successful stock commit
x-gopos-stock-opname.idempotency: UUID or Idempotency-Key per write operation
x-gopos-stock-opname.draft_delete_rule: DRAFT + active period only; logical delete mirrors Web ajax_delete and does not change stock/journal.

x-gopos-mobile-item-lookup.last_hpp_basis: latest active-period FIFO lot HPP with hpp_default fallback
x-gopos-mobile-item-lookup.last_supplier_basis: latest direct purchase for same parent item

x-gopos-draft-recovery.sale_source: trx_kasir_hold ACTIVE owned by current user
x-gopos-draft-recovery.consignment_source: trx_konsi status DRAFT owned by id_user
x-gopos-draft-recovery.stock_opname_source: trx_opname status DRAFT owned by created_by
x-gopos-draft-recovery.purchase_reason: trx_beli has no safe draft status + owner dimension; Mobile Direct Purchase should use atomic commit and Patch 428 retry queue.

x-gopos-offline-retry.envelope_idempotency: operation_id UUID scoped to authenticated device; same payload replays, different payload conflicts

get.x-gopos-notes: Patch 504: endpoint ini menjadi source-of-truth instruksi settlement Mobile. Field legacy preview tetap dipertahankan dan ditambah required_total/cash_amount/non_cash_amount/refund_mode/allowed_methods/suggested_method/suggested_account_id/reference_required/destination_required/is_complete/can_post.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Alias client_action_id/post_request_uuid. Direkomendasikan untuk retry finalisasi Retur dari Mobile.

reason.description: Opsional/kompatibilitas Mobile; alasan draft authoritative tetap berasal dari CREATE/UPDATE draft.

settlement.description: Settlement refund. Boleh dihilangkan bila Main dapat membentuk settlement aman otomatis (contoh TUNAI penuh atau seluruh retur mengurangi piutang).

method.description: Untuk split cash+non-cash, isi channel bagian non-cash (TRANSFER/QRIS).

post.x-gopos-idempotency: Patch 504: client_action_id/post_request_uuid UUID atau Idempotency-Key. Settlement yang di-resolve Main ikut masuk canonical request hash; retry UUID + settlement identik aman, payload settlement berbeda menghasilkan 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Retur POSTED direplay memakai settlement tersimpan bila client tidak mengirim settlement lagi.
post.x-gopos-notes: Patch 504: finalisasi tetap memakai engine Web authoritative. Nested settlement diterjemahkan ke field engine existing. Bila settlement tidak dikirim, Main hanya auto-resolve kasus yang aman (refund_required=0 atau refund 100% tunai); kebutuhan non-tunai yang belum lengkap menghasilkan RETURN_SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED. Mismatch menghasilkan RETURN_SETTLEMENT_MISMATCH dengan required_total/cash_amount/non_cash_amount/difference.

get.x-gopos-notes: Data default selalu hari server saat request. Omzet hanya transaksi SELESAI dan tidak terhapus; net_omzet = omzet - Retur Penjualan POSTED hari itu. Patch 406 memisahkan TRANSFER dan QRIS berdasarkan payment_channel; data jenis_bayar=2 historis yang tidak dapat dibedakan tetap berada pada bucket TRANSFER_QRIS (LEGACY). Expected cash dihitung ulang dari transaksi tunai dan mutasi aktif pada shift aktif. Scope role_level=1 = seluruh kasir; role lain = transaksi sendiri.

Mengembalikan server_time, queue count, mapping count, capability retry/conflict detection, client status contract PENDING/APPLIED/CONFLICT/REJECTED, dan operation types lintas Penjualan/Pembelian/Konsinyasi/Stok Opname. Scope selalu current authenticated device.

Dipakai setelah timeout/network drop untuk mengetahui apakah operation sudah diterima/diterapkan server. client_status=APPLIED berarti side effect domain telah sukses dan aman dihapus dari queue lokal.
